title.en: Electric current does not replace what Electric 15 vs Electric 20 Concrete Pump lists

h1.en: Electric current does not replace what Electric 15 vs Electric 20 Concrete Pump lists
h1.zh: 「电流」不能替换电动15和电动20混凝土泵有什么不同列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and Electric 20 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both list 8–10 m³/h, but Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, a 100–125 mm pipe and 450 kg, while Electric 20 lists 22 kW, an 80 mm pipe, 10 MPa and 900 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。两边理论输送量都是 8–10 m³/h，但电动15标出 15 kW、管内径 100–125 mm、450 kg，电动20标出 22 kW、80 mm、10 MPa、900 kg。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current: Ohm's Law with Voltage source TeX. Electric 15 and Electric 20 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Max. aggregate size: Electric 15 lists 1–3 cm. Electric 20 lists 1–2 cm. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current页上的Ohm's Law with Voltage source TeX。电动15和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。输送管内径：电动15标出 100–125 mm；电动20标出 80 mm。电动15有、电动20没有的行：垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；整机重量 450 kg。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Both list 8–10 m³/h, but Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, a 100–125 mm pipe and 450 kg, while Electric 20 lists 22 kW, an 80 mm pipe, 10 MPa and 900 kg. Delivery pipe diameter: Electric 15 lists 100–125 mm. Electric 20 lists 80 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The shared 8–10 m³/h band does not make the pipe, motor or weight interchangeable. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 两边理论输送量都是 8–10 m³/h，但电动15标出 15 kW、管内径 100–125 mm、450 kg，电动20标出 22 kW、80 mm、10 MPa、900 kg。外形尺寸：电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm；电动20标出 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。电动20有、电动15没有的行：最大出口压力 10 MPa；料斗容积 0.25 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；整机重量 900 kg。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Missing entries stay blank. Dimensions: Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Electric 15 lists entries that Electric 20 does not: Vertical delivery height 15–20 m. Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m. Total weight 450 kg. Open /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15 and /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动15标出 15 kW；电动20标出 22 kW。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 8–10 m³/h。相同的 8–10 m³/h 不能把管径、电机或重量互相挪用。

body.en: Motor power: Electric 15 lists 15 kW. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. The same shown value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 8–10 m³/h on both pages. Electric 20 lists entries that Electric 15 does not: Max. outlet pressure 10 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.25 m³. Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m. Main unit weight 900 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 最大骨料粒径：电动15标出 1–3 cm；电动20标出 1–2 cm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/，看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same motor power as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 15 kW. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 15 kW。电动20标出 22 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same max. aggregate size as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 1–3 cm. Electric 20 lists 1–2 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 1–3 cm。电动20标出 1–2 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same delivery pipe diameter as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的输送管内径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 100–125 mm. Electric 20 lists 80 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 100–125 mm。电动20标出 80 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is vertical delivery height missing on Electric 20?
question.zh: 为什么电动20没有垂直输送高度？

answer.en: The Electric 20 page does not list that label. Electric 15 lists 15–20 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current.
answer.zh: 电动20这一页没有标出这个标题。电动15标出的是 15–20 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_current画面里印出的数字。
